Philosopher, physician, and humanitarian Albert Schweitzer said, "Example is not the main thing in influencing others; it is the only thing."

I believe that setting a good example by ones own behavior is the best way to influence other people.

I believe this because people look up to others, actions speak louder than words, and it's always in peoples life.

I will explain my reasoning so let me get right into it.

The first reason as to why I believe setting a good example by ones own behavior is the best way to influence others is because people look up to others.

Both adults and kids alike are influenced by other peoples actions everyday.

Everybody has a hero or role model that they look upon and are motivated to copy them.

It's what the role model does that effects what the person that looks up to them do.

For example, let's say that an actor on a kids television show is acting all good and respecting his parents.

The results would be that kids that watch that show would copy him by acting good as well as respecting their parents.

The second reason as to why I believe setting a good example, by ones own behavior, is the best way to influence others is because actions speak louder than words.

This old saying is a swell example of this.

Actions are usually found to give off more feeling and emotion than words.

Since actions are visible they have more of an effect on inspiring and influencing other people.

For example, giving a high five gives off a better example of being a good sport than saying, "Good job."

The last reason as to why I believe setting a good example, by ones own behavior, is the best way to influence others is because it's always in peoples life.

People don't really know how to act when they are born, they attempt to mimic other people.

Kids grow up following the examples that their parents gave them.

Words don't really mean anything to them since they don't understand them yet.

As people grow up their ideals and ideas are constantly changing by other people around them.

People are then not effected by words much than they are effected by other peoples actions.

Setting examples will always be in our lives, no matter what.

Some people say that there are other ways to influence others.

They say that taking physical action is a better way to influence others.

These people are wrong.

They're wrong because physical action doesn't really influence others, it actually makes a person want to be the opposite.

Furthermore, setting good examples work out better than physical action because it's more influential from a long distance than being up close to physically inspire someone.

In conclusion, because of people looking up to others, actions speaking louder than words and it always being in peoples life, my reasons are valid.

These are all the reasons as to why I believe setting a good example by ones own behavior is the best way to influence others.

Additionally, you should go out and set a good example for your kids or friends, since it's the only way to influence others.

Home school, this is a very popular subject nowadays. This is a program that benefits a lot of children around the world that for different circumstances they can't attend to a school building. But what happens when a child has the physical and mental capacity to attend school but still decides to have home school, are they going to have the same benefits as the rest of students that attend to school?

Every child has the right to be educated. There exists plenty of qualities and values that a student can develop in a classroom such as: honesty, friendship, respect, leadership, etc. These are just some of all the attributes a student can gain by attending to school, but one of the most important qualities that a human can learn is the interaction with others. This is because the world is based on that, every single day people interact with other people and learn form each other, this is the way the world works.

In school, students have to interact with their classmates and teachers day by day. There are group assignments were teachers put you in a group were nobody knows each other so they can work together and hopefully build a good friendship. Sports in school are also a great way to interact with others, teachers encourage students to participate in sport activities after school. If the student doesn't like sports there also are different clubs in school in which students can participate.

In conclusion the home school program can teach all the knowledge a student needs such as sciences or maths but, it doesnt teach the values and attributes a human needs. The future generations that the world need are correct people with good values that will help the progress of the world.

It will also show you further more into the woods. And it will show you the reality of camping. And also because I am sure you will like to eat a chocolaty marshmallow cookie. Right?

One topic that is frequently debated today is school districts offering programs that allow students to graduate in three years instead of the traditional four years. Some people see this program as a new and more sophisticated way of graduating from high school. They feel that this program can give students the step up in life to be prepare for a new world outside of high school and that it will give them the advantage of time to plan the career they wanna study. I believe, students should graduate from high school in three years instead of the traditional four years because it will give them more time to plan for future careers, the program makes you challenge your self in case there is a similar case in the future, and once you get done with the three year program you would not have to worry about all the stress.

One reason why students should consider graduating in three years is the time advantage. Believe it or not, planing what career you wanna study takes a long time, it is not like you pick any career and that is it, no, first you gotta find out the cost of the whole career, then you are going to find a school that is best known for the highest number of students graduating from the same career and so on, one year is a lot of time but it depends on the student to take advantage of it. If you dont have the funds to go to a university or a college this time advantage can give you the opportunity to be able to work for one year and save up all the money to continue with your learning path. There is a bunch of other options on what to do with this period of time for example, if you decide that you are not going to college because you dont think you will do good, you always have the option to join the work force.

Second reason why students should graduate in three years is because in order to graduate in three years students will need to challenge them selves. When we talk about the program challenging students I refer to all the extra courses a student will need to take either in the summer or evenings after high school in order to graduate in three years, in some cases students are not able to take elective courses. Every hard decision requires a will and in this case is the will to obtain a certificate showing that you overcame every obstacle in life. Having all this challenges helps you start preparing your mind for the new phase of your life. Life outside of high school is not easy as American movies picture it, every body starts from scratch and only the smartest and hard workers will succeed.

The third and last reason to graduate from high school in three years is that once you get done with the three years program, you will not have to worry about the stress that high schools gives you. Stress is a big problem nowadays to kids in the ages from 14 to 20 causing them to commit actions that they would regret in the future, for example, dropping out of high school, according to a social experiment made by the university of Virginia, 2 out of 10 students drop out every year.

As you have read, its better for a student to graduate in a three years term instead of the four traditional years because this would have a maximum effect on the student future and it will help the student prepare for the new world. The first impressions are always in our memories, almost impossible to change. People always says that the fist impression is the most important thing because people can know who you are. I disagree that the first impressions are very difficult to change.

There is no thing impossible to change. Sometimes it takes long time to see if the first impressions was right or not. For example, I met a person two years ago at school. She spoke the same language of mine. I was very excited to meet her, but she wasn't that much excited. She didn't talk to me. She was just steering at me without saying anything. I had a awful impression about her. I thought she is not friendly, and serene. The next day of school, I was sitting in the cafeteria by myself, and suddenly she invited me to come and set with her. Also, after I moved to a different building next to her building, she walked with me every day to school, and helped me to understand the system in school. Now she is one of my best friends. My first impression about her was wrong.

On the other hand, my first impression of an old friend of mine was amazing. I thought she is smart, nice, and helpful. One time, my art teacher liked my drawing. I draw a boat in the sea and it was fantastic, my teacher told me to finish it because she would like to take it. I was very happy because I am not good at drawing. My friend asked me if I need help to finish it faster, so I can give it to my teacher before she leave. I didn't hesitate to accept her offer. Unfortunately, she ruined my picture by highlighting the sea in a black color. After that I figured out that it wasn't by mistake because it is very obvious that sea shouldn't be black. she was jealous because she didn't draw anything and she heard the teacher saying good things about my art work. Because of theses two examples I believed that judging people based on my first impression was not enough and fair.

First impressions aren't necessary humans, it could be places, animals, or country. For instance, I obligate to leave my old job to work somewhere else for better income and experience. My first day of my new job was very difficult, as a cashier it requires me to memorize a lot of vegetables and fruits cods. My impression was this job is difficult to handle, and I will not be able to make a friends like my old job. I was sorrowful and disappointed, but I remembered that my first impression can be wrong. I might need to understand the job more, practice, and I will be fine. Honestly, I realized that the employees are very supportive. It was not that hard to memorize the cods. I start changing my first impression about my job. I learned to give a second chance to myself and to everyone.

Some say that a lot of time the first impression is your image that you want to presented to people. Also, it is impossible to change it, but over time people can change their idea. A lot of times people forgot the first impression about someone because of their actions and their ability to do something. If someone want to change the first impression about them, they have to change first.

To conclude, It is never impossible to change the first impression about someone. If someone trying to change others about their first impression, they need to be patients and the situation will prove to them that they were wrong. Believing in ourselves and trying our best is the best thing anyone can do to change their first bad impressions about them.

Should the Art, Drama,and Music Classes be a Requirement Class ? or Elective class?

Should the love for music, drama ,and art classes a requirement for everybody? One of the most controversial issue among students in the school is if the art, music ,and drama classes should be or not a requirement. Some students believe that the art, music,and drama classes are a great option for all the students. These students believe that all the art classes have the ability to expand your mind and your creativity. Obviously, these students are involve in these areas. However, based on my own experience there are many factors why some students do not decide to take these classes as an option,for example: some students do not have enough time, other student do not have some kind of ability in these areas ,and in other cases some students simply do not have any interest in these classes.

As we all know, all the art, music ,and drama classes take a lot dedication from part of the student. Not just only during the school, but also after school. For example, if a student have to take the music class and if he wants to have a good grade in the class. This student will need to practice every single day,in order to perfection ate his ability playing his instrument. But unfortunately,this is not an option for all the students specially in high school. Most of the students do not have the time to do it. Because of their work, homework ,or just because they help at home. Based on my own experience, when i was in

Bolivia. We took art, music, and drama classes as requirement to graduate. In my situation I was almost to fail the music and drama class due to my responsibilities at home. Therefore, practice my instrument for my music class or memorize my lines for my drama class was basically impossible for me.

Additionally, in all these classes the student need to have some experience for example in the music class the student should a least know how play an instrument or for the art class you should know how paint or draw. Personally, I was not good neither drawing nor playing an instrument. Even if i just practice only in the school,I never improved. But I remember how some of my friends did never practice after school like me. But somehow they were doing so well. They had very good scores in all those classes. This is because they had an natural ability in their veins. That why they did it so well without any complication. Therefore, for me this became just an unfair requirement.

A lot people say: " If you want to do something well, you have to do it with passion". Although this statement it is true. In our present we can see how people do so many things without any interest. Nevertheless, they do it because they have the obligation to do it. In the case of the art,music or drama classes. All these classes required at least some interest from part of the student. Otherwise, the quality of their work will decrease. In my case I did not have any aspiration on these subjects. But this was not just only my situation but it is also for many other students in high school. Some people will say that it is not about if you like it or not. But with respect of these classes. We all know as a general knowledge that most of the Universities are not interesting on these subjects. Except for those Colleges who are specifically dedicate on the camp of art, music, and drama.

To conclude, the classes of art, music and drama all of them are amazing. However, all of them take time, dedication and another efforts. Probably, for some students this classes are a great option. Nevertheless, for many other students these subjects are very complex and this will become a problem for them. For other students, the time of dedication will not adjust to their lifestyle. And the last but not the less important of the cases, the students who simply do not have any interest to learn in the area of arts. For all these reasons, these subjects should be electives,as it always was.

Dear School Board,

My name is Generic_Name, and I attend Generic_School I have heard about your plans to extend the school day, and I am concerned about how the students will react. I understand that the school board wants to add one and a half hours to school each day, but I believe this will have a negative impact on students. A number of students who participate in after school activities will have less time to complete homework as well as missing assignments, many students may feel pressured to learn an extensive amount of material everyday which could lead to them falling behind, and students could also become stressed between balancing school work and other daily activities.

In other words, students who participate in sports or clubs may have difficulty completing homework due to the fact that their time is decreased. Attending school for more than eight hours followed by attending sports or clubs could be followed by complications. These students would not have as much time as others to finish/complete homework, which could lead to a decrease in their grade. Students also enjoy free time to spend with their family or loved ones, but this opportunity to make plans could be slimmed with the students being busy most of the time. Not having enough free time might pressure the student to complete all the assignments, which could cause them to become sleep deprived. Sleep deprivation could lead to concentration issues as well as having difficulty staying awake throughout the school day. A student should not have to experience stress or have difficulty making time for other daily activities, all of these factors could lead to a negative environment for a student as well as a teachers and staff.

Similarly, students may also be pressured to learn an excessive amount of material, which could cause grades to drop. Research conducted by the Generic_School shows that when schools have longer days, lessons increase daily by 78% worldwide. Teachers may decide to put it an extra lesson everyday which could lead to a course that is too rapid for the student to handle. If a students learns too much excessive material in one day it could lead to difficulty of comprehending what is being taught, and could cause them to fall behind on their schoolwork. If a student starts to fall behind, it could cause them to also have difficulty catching up on new material that is being covered with the class, this could lead to the student to becoming stressed. Teachers could also be affected by students struggling to catch up and it could slowdown their lesson plans, this would lead to students and teachers not covering/reviewing the material they need to, at the right time. Teachers and students should not have to experience day-to-day stress in school, this could lead to the school not being organized, because no class would be on schedule with the classes they are similar to.

Likewise, students as well as teachers would become more pressured between balancing work that has yet to be completed and other daily activities. Teachers could struggle between creating lesson plans, keeping grades up to date, and handling their personal free time. Students could also struggle with making plans with their family, completing school work on time, and attending extracurricular activities. This could all put a student in an stressful position, and it could lead to them stressing out about working, and to students contemplating about quitting a sport or activity. Teachers could also be affected negatively, they could be instructed to continue on with the lesson without having time to catch up students who are struggling with the concept of the new material. Students and teachers shouldn't have to make decisions between aiding or continuing to do things, this could lead to the grades of many students dropping and could lead to the teacher struggling between lessons, and leaving some students without proper aid.

In conclusion, students as well as teachers would be negatively impacted if one and a half hours of school were added to each day. Students who participate in sports/clubs would have less time to complete their work, students would also be pressured to learn an extensive amount of material which could lead to their grade percentage decreasing, and students as well as teachers would feel more pressure between balancing school work, and free time. All of these factors would leave the faculty as well as students with a negative environment to work in. The people in the school building shouldn't have to experience any stress over adding one and a half hours to a school day. I hope you can take my views under consideration for the benefiting of the students.

Sincerely,

Generic_Name

Schools should not control these types of student involvements, these decisions should be left to the families and students.

-The decision for a student to be involved in an activity does not have to deal with school control. If students want to get involved into extracurricular activities, schools should not have to control these types of problems.

-It's the student's decision: If the student signs into a football club after school, the school should not control what time you can spend on the club. He or she will have time to do his or her homework later, or the student can sign into a homework club after school. This should only depend on the family, not the school.

The student obviously has to have time for school and homeworks or assignments. So if the student wants to be involved on a club, he can choose to go to homework clubs. If a school does not have a homework club, and the student wants to be on a club after school, he can:

Talk to the conselour about how to manage the student's time with school and assignments.

Talk to the conselour and ask him/her if it's possible to change any of the student's classes for a CORE class at the beginning of the year, so that the student is able to do homework or any other assignments.

Some days, whenever the student has a project or a big assignment, he should choose to not go to the club only if he has something really complicated or important that requires more time at home to do assignments.\

In conclusion, students and families should be the only ones to control how much activities or time they want to spend on a club or doing assignments, schools should not control these types of issues. Let the student decide.

I think students would benefit from being able to attend classes from home, because it would be easier for them to stay focused, give themselves as much time as possible, and get to know what the best and correct choice is for them.

Majority of the time kids struggle focusing in a class full of friends and strangers, which causes them to lose focus in the assignments they're given and start having conversations with other classmates. Some know that they're the type of person that can't keep their mind in one certain place, so their minds wonder off into a whole different planet. Meanwhile the other half of students know that they're capable of staying focused no matter what the situation is. Doing work online though, prevents all of that from happening. It gives students time to think about what exactly it is that they're doing and need to get done, and prevent any mistakes from happening on a certain task or assignment. Staying focusing is very important, if students stay focused then they'll get things done in time or even done before the actual due date or time, and not have to worry about doing it later on.

Giving them enough time as possible to get tasks done is important. Most teachers will give you a certain time limit to get things done, which of course will cause them to get it done in the certain amount of time they were given so that they get it all done as quick as possible. Online on the other hand, can also have certain due dates and times that you have to turn work in but you're more relaxed and calm about things because you have more time in your hand and can think things more in depth, instead of just having to think of things right out of the top of their heads. Doing things on their own time and paste is best for any student, they can find it easier to concentrate and don't have to think oh no I still haven't finished this, or it's almost time to hand it in but i'm barely done with the first section.

As students spend more time alone, they sometimes tend to think about what's best for them as an individual. Some might say that, they work better independently, because they know they aren't able to handle being around other students 24/7, losing their ability to focus, or just hate being around people in general because they know what others are capable of. Whereas, other students may think the opposite and feel like they can work being around other people no matter what type of situation they're in. Just working alone can get them to really go in some deep thinking about what's the best descision for them and know what's going to be the best choice in the future or even in the present.

In conclusion, I think attending classes from home has plenty of benefits, like giving students more time to think, having a lot more time to focus, and getting to know whats best for them. Just imagine being in a class full of 100 students everyday, all talking at the same exact time and yelling across the classroom trying to get friends attention, what would you do?

Can you believe that on average 60% of students do not participate in an after school activity? I know I can, I'm apart of that 60%. Can you also believe that the principal has decided that all students must participate in at least one extracurricular activity? Now this is unbelievable, many students, including myself, are extremely busy and simply don't have time to stay after school. It's hard trying to juggle schoolwork, social life, family life, and personal problems, let alone adding one more ball to your juggling circus act by staying after school. I know that staying after school and participating in extracurricular activities can have many benefits, like finding new interests and making new friends, but many students don't have the possibility to stay after school due to their busy schedules. I completely disagree with the principal that all students must participate in at least one extracurricular activity due to the fact that some students are busy and don't have time, others participate in other activities outside of school, and it would cost the school more money to fund the activities.

One reason why I disagree with the principal about staying after school is that many students don't have the opportunity to stay after school due to them being busy outside of school. Many students have commitments and responsibilities outside of school, such as going to work,or taking care of a younger sibling, which serve as an impediment and prohibits the student from staying after school. If these students were demanded by the principal that they have to stay after school, then these students would end up losing not only their jobs, but the trust and responsibilities their bosses and parents have put for them as well. Many students do not like the idea of staying after school due to the fact that it would cause more stress on them by trying to keep up with school, work, after school, family life, etc. From all the stress they would be receiving it could cause a toll on their mental health as well as their physical health, and could cause them to do poorly in school, as well as in other areas of their life. I know parents would not want this for their children, and would not want for them to risk their jobs, responsibilities, and especially their health all for an extra activity after school that they are too busy for.

Like the students who are busy, there are many students that can not participate in an extracurricular activity after school because they are already participating in other activities outside of school. Many students participate in sports, where they are in a club or league and they have to make it to practice or compete in tournaments after school. Other students go to academies for tutoring so they can get extra help in school, or to enhance their learning and advance in their studies. Some students also participate in different programs offered by the community, such as Girl Scouts, Boy Scouts, Girls and Boys Club, music programs, environmental programs,etc. Typically these programs have meetings almost everyday which members of these clubs have to attend. In many cases students are in more than one of these activities after school that take up almost all their time, and therefore they cannot commit to any more after school activities.

Not only would staying after school for an extracurricular activity affect the students, but it would also affect the school as well as the school's budget due to the fact that the school will need to spend more money to fund all of the activities. The more sports and activities the school offers and needs to add to fit everyone in at least one activity, the more the school will have to spend on adding activities as well as any equipment needed for those activities. Not to mentions with all these activities we need experienced teachers and coaches to assess with all the students and run the activities. With teachers having to stay after school they would have to get paid for those extra hours they have worked. You also have to take into consideration transportation. How are the students going to get home after school? Many parents are still busy working and might not have time to pick their child up, others might not even have a car. Yes, you can get enough buses to transport everyone back home, but more after school buses means spending more money on drivers and buses. With all this money being spent for after school there won't be enough money to spend and fund activities for the actual school day, which in my opinion more important than after school.

In conclusion, I disagree with the principal that all students must participate in at least one extracurricular activity because some students are busy and don't have time, others participate in other activities outside of school, and it would cost the school more money to fund activities. The principal needs to take into consideration these reasonings and consider the viewpoints and opinions of students, staff, and administrators to change their decision on making everyone stay after school, and instead change their proposal so it can fit everyone's needs.

True self-esteem comes from achievement because it shows us our true potential. For example, Generic_Name, my youngest sister, loves science. Her teachers tried to comfort her, but she never listens easily. The next year when science fair came around, she was well-prepared. She decided to do a topic on volcanoes. She researched for days and weeks to gain all the sources. She even created a model of a giant, live volcano. She placed second in her class and went to regional. After she had proved herself, she went on to test her potential. She decided to go on to even harder topics for next year. A study done by UVA's students showed that students become more confident after they achieve something their heart desires; they are more likely to push themselves to harder levels. They have a higher rate of getting out of their comfort zones and succeeding. The source of true self-esteem is achievement because it shows us our true potential.

True self-esteem comes from achievement because it motivates us to work hard. For example, one time in chemistry, we were playing Kahoot to prepare for our big test. I had been leading for the past two games, and my teacher along with my peers were giving me endless praise. I got caught up in the moment too much that I started slacking off. I placed first again with a new high score. In 2014, a group of students from UCLA were put under an experiment. They were given an AHL test with fairly easy questions. Next week, another test was given to both of the teams with even harder questions. Each of the students took longer to finish. The results in the end showed that the team that was not praised for their first test had scored 40% higher than last time. While the team that was praised had a drop of 30% in their test scores. Our achievements give us a boost in our self-esteem and motivation to work hard.

Nowadays, there is a heated debate over whether it's a good idea that students select courses which are related to their future career. As far as I'm concerned, I think students should select courses of study in school which will guide them toward a specific career.

First of all, students who select couses that are related to career will have much more time to prepare future career. As an old saying goes:'Practice makes perfect'. Students will be able to study during high school for 3 years and it's such a long time for students to improve themselves gragually. With a sufficient preparation, students will learn about their career deeply. It's a good choice for students to build their own career goals and make it come true with enthusiasm heart.

Also, Students can receive the knowledge what they want, and it has impact on their future will encourage them to study with passion. They may think it will feed them back in the future. Moreover, it helps students to be more competitive in applying college since the high school courses maybe connected to college couses.

Third, it hepls students build their characters. Students can have a better understanding of society and build a sense of responsilibity during the study of career. In this view, when students are working in a company, they will have a nice behavior and apply all the knowledge they learned into the project. It's also good for country's economic, the talent people will improve the development of society.

However, some people think that select the courses which are related to career will limit the students' future goals and hobbies. Even though this, selecting courses which are related to career also have many advantages. For instance, students can imrove their ability to behave professional in the future, country need talent people to run the ecomomic, college will accept the students who are good at major and so on. As the considering of students may change their mind, I recommand parents and teachers give students avaliable advice before selecting courses. It will help students to identify themselves. In addition, with their helps, students also need to considerate their future carefully since it may determines who they are going to be.

To put it in a nutshell, to select courses which are related to career is benefial for the development of students' future. It's like a lighthouse which lead students to a reliable path.

When meeting someone for the first time, you should always be on your best behavior and act with respect and dignity. Eye contact is very important to ensure that you are being attentive and are completely immersed in the conversation. While first impressions are important, they are not impossible to reverse if one does not go in your favor.

One can easily make a good first impressions only to act disrespectful later, which in many cases, overpower the good first impressions. One can also make a not so great first impressions but turn around for better. While it may be difficult to recover from a bad impressions, it can be done. The idea of ''never judging a book by it's cover'', would appropriately fit this scenario. Since we are each own individual character we cannot immerse ourselves in the minds of other to truly understand what they are feeling or thinking. Many people may become nervous during the first impressions putting avoid between eye contact and such.

Usually one counter with someone is not enough to judge them off of or to determine kind of person someone is. Until a person is comfortable with their surrounding and the surrounding or other. It is very possible that they may not act as friendly as they would in a situation when they are at ease. furthermore, it is not an entirely fair assessment to judge a person without a few encounters.

It is wise never to judge someone off of their first impressions,however, there are exceptions, if someone in a cynical, sarcastic, rude or arrogant during a first encounter, this may be typically behavior. Someone who attempts to belittle you or acts as if they are one higher level, is most likely always this way. A person who preoccupies themselves while in a conversation by things such a texting or listening to others things that are not a part of the conversation or interrupts is most likely displaying their normal behavior. Doing such things are rude, disrespectful and will be hard to recover from.

Even if some portray themselves to be rude individuals, a judgment should not be made off of one single encounter. People should be given more than one change to display themselves as they truly are. Judgments should made after a few, lengthy encounters to ensure that true characters is shown. Give everyone a few opportunities to prove themselves as good minded individuals.

Self-esteem is having confident in yourself of being able to achieve a valuable assets. It is also the most important and valuable element in order to receive success in life. How can u build your self-esteem? Some people believe praising a student's work helps them build their self-esteem. Others believe achievement is the most accurate way of building a strong self-esteem. Does true self-esteem come from praise or does it come from achievement? Achievement is the true source of building a self esteem because it helps student set their goal higher and it motivates student to do more work.

Achievement is the best way to build a strong self-esteem because it helps student set their goal higher. Even a smallest achievement will make an individual a confident person. Watching themselves successfully complete a task will boost their self-esteem up. In fact, students will be wanting to set their goal higher by dealing with more difficult tasks which will help maintain their self-esteem and also expect much better results. Setting their goal higher would be the first step towards building a strong self-esteem. For example, achieving good grades on tests and exams, student will realize how important it is and will be wanting to receive even better scores next time.

There is no other way to motivate a student than showing their own achievements. By looking at their own results students will have confident to do their best. Their self-esteem will want them to do even better than their previous results. Students will not want to give up and will be wanting to try their best in order to beat their last score. For instance, a student taking their test will remember what they got last time and their only goal during that time to get better score than last time. No matter how small the achievement was, even if they failed their last test. Their self-esteem will motivate them from not failing again and getting a better score.

Some people might argue saying praising a student's work is the right way to build self-esteem. However, praising can undermines learning by lowering standards and also mislead student by not putting their best effort. Achievements are the most important element in building a strong self-esteem. It is also a efficient way to motivating individuals. The most beneficial way for students to set their standard high and receiving success is achievements. It does not matter how small or big the achievement is as long as a lesson has been learn from that.

Some people believe that students must be self-confident in order to learn, others believe that praising students even when their work is deficient helps them build self-steem. By looking at the circumstances, I believe that true self-steem really comes from achievement.

To begin with, when students are assigned any type of work in school, teachers expect them to do their best, all teachers are by their side to help and take questions in any ocasion. For example, when students are anyhow unsure about how to do the work assigned the teachers will gladly help them by explaning it further and showing them that they are capable of making it possible. Junior year at school has been very challenging for me, for the second semester I was assigned a class project that I found very difficult, when I finally finished and was ready to present my teacher was honest and said that I could have done better, by doing that he encouraged me to work harder and do further research and hopefully in the future not make the same mistake again.

Secondly, high schools are here to prepare students for the future when they take their education further and attend colleges or universities. When attending universities, students will have to do a big portion of their work on their own, either by doing research or seeking further help from their professors, so teachers letting students know when their work is fragmentary is fundamental for their growth academically. A good example for this is, soccer players have to work really hard to be professional and good at the sport. Coaches never give the players a break, they are always training, practicing and when they eventually comit any type of flaw during important games their coaches will definetely let them know what their mistake was so they can improve for the next game. This teaches them that their true self-steem will come from their achievements.

Some people may argue that praising a student's work will help them build self-steem. For example, they contend that students must be self-confident in order to learn any content. That is an understandable concern, however, when teachers praise a student's work in order to help them build self-steem or to make them confident even when their work is flawed will create a false statement in their minds. If students have their work praised when it is clearly not well done or they for some reason did not put all their effort into it, they will think that working very little or turning assignments in that do not meet the criterias will get them a good grade and they will not learn through their mistakes.

In conclusion, students are here to learn through their mistakes and to know that being told by their teacher that their work has any type of fragment is completely fine and it is for their own good. It can really help them do better not just academically but professionally when they become grown adults and go out into the real world to perform whatever career they have chosen. I believe that there is nothing better in the entire world for any student than achieving self-steem through their own achievements, knowing that they have worked hard to put something good on the table and at the end of the day they are proud with how it turned out.

In the society we live in today it is always good to help others, specially students by showing them that they are capable of doing something that they will remember that turned out the way they expected through their own achievements.

Some may agrue that in praising a students work even when the work is not the students best effort, will boost their self-confidence, however I personally think otherwise, students should not be praised on something that is not done correctly to build their self-esteem becasue it will just keep them from growing. Students self-esteem should be built by their achivements, it will help them grow in the future, show them what they are capable of doing, and will be more self-confident to learn.

To begin, if a student is being praised on something they did not do correctly then they will not benefit from that and they will not grow. Self-esteem should come from a students hard work that is done with good effort. For example my little cousin, who is nine years old, has always been slef-confident because her parents have been praising her work for so long but when she showed her teacher her work at school, she was told that it was all wrong. My cousin felt embarssed and her self-esteem had lowered. If her parents had told her that it was wrong and had not praised it then she could have improved on her skills before showing her teacher.

Secondly, a students achievements will not only bring up their self-esteem but it will also show them what they are capable of. If a students self-esteem is coming from someone praising their work when it is done poorly they will never improve from that nor will they know if they could have done better. My parents have always told me to stirve for bigger things because they know that I can always imrpove from where I am, and that always builds up my self-confidence because I know I can do better. If they had been praising me for work that was wrong then I would not have the self-esteem I have now.

Additionally, a student knowing that they are capable of more will build up their self-confidence in learning. When a student gets something right on a problem they feel more confident in themselves and makes them want to keep learning to see if they can do more, but if a teacher is giving them credit for someting worng then they will never learn.

When I get something wrong I would not like it if I got rewarded it for it because it does not help me at all and I will not have the motivation to keep going in class because I know that I will keep doing the same mistake.

A students self-esteem should come from their achivments not from people praising their work when the student has showen little effort. Students that have self-esteem by their achievements will improve themselves, know what they can be capable of, and will be more confident in learning new things. It is not right to give credit to those who do not do well in their assignments so they can have more self-condfidence, they have to get that confidence by their achievements.

The city assembly is considering a new law that would make teenagers have a 10 p. m.curfew on the weekdays, and a midnight curfew during the weekends. If they are seen out of their houses after that time, there will be consequences for transgressing the law. Some people believe that having a curfew for teenagers is good, because parents would have more control over them; however, by having a curfew teenagers may feel that they don't have enough freedom, therefore becoming more rebellious.

To begin with, if teenagers have a curfew they would think that they don't have enough time to go out with their friends ,or play outside the house. For example, if they want to go to the movie theater during the weekdays, but the movie starts at 9:30 they wouldn't be able to go because they would get out of the movie theater past curfew.

On the other hand teenagers don't like to be told what to do, they want to be free and adventurous, meanwhile, they don't pay attention to their parents. So if teenagers get a curfew, they simply won't pay attention to it like they don't pay attention to what their parents say. They do all this because they are not mature enough to recognize that parents only want the best for their childrens, and don't want anything bad to happen to them.

Moreover, some teenagers don't like being at home, so they stay out of their houses until late at night. Maybe some of them are having problems with their parents, or simply they just don't like to be at home because they get bored. For example, if there is no tv in the house, the teenager is going to get bored because he may think that there is nothing else to do, so he is going to leave his house to find something fun to do instead of staying at home all day. Whatever the reason is, they will try to be out on the steets no matter if they have a curfew or not.

To conclude, if the city assembly is thinking about implementing a 10 p. m. curfew during weekdays ,and a midnight curfew on the weekdays, they have to consider that: teenagers need enough time to go out with their friends, they want to be free and experiment new things, and lastly some of them don't like being at home all day. A curfew will make teenagers feel that they dont have control over themselves, and like they don't have the right to decide when to go out and when to stay at home.

I tend to get side-tracked or procrastinate on things, but when I don't I feel as if the more I do the more I accomplish.

Thomas Jefferson once wrote, " Determine never to idle... It is wonderful how much may be done if we are always doing." I have to agree with him because not much is done if you're not working to get things done. There is always something you may want to achieve whether it's something you put off to the side or something you are interested in, like art. I believe we accomplish more when doing something because it's like hard work it always pays off at the end, also you can end up being surprised of the results after realizing how much you have accomplished, plus you don't end up being a procrastinator who never gets work done.

By working hard you always get something out of the way and are always completing your tasks. School is a big example of that, If you are always on track and turning in work on time, then there is no reason why you shouldn't be close to your goal. I know it's not so easy for everyone but as long as you give it your all then you will feel accomplished, which is what matters at the end of the day. Even if you don't have homework or a job, you can find an activity that you like, the point of it all is that you are occupied doing something and not just looking for an excuse to not do anything.

If not seeing results is your problem, then get that out of your head because no matter what, you will always surprise yourself with the massive achievement. I know a lot of people who put things to the side because they thought that their outcome would disappoint them but what they don't know is that there is always good endings to things. For instance, when I make a nail design and mess up I don't just leave it there and forget about it, instead I make it into something that ends up surprising everyone. You don't just give up on things you have to just go for it, because at least it keeps you occupied because you never know what's going to happen. By the end you will realize," Wow time goes by so fast."

All has been positive, but if there's one thing that can mess it all up is procrastination. You'll be motivated one minute and then out of nowhere just decide to leave things for later. It's hard to say because it also depends how you are feeling that day, you never know the series of events that could happen that causes such thing. For example, you took a test and the decide not to do anything else throughout the day, crazy because you don't know about what things could affect your productivity and/or your motivation.

We always accomplish more when we are occupied. So, in my case I say that if you don't do anything then you're obviously not going to see results, unless you can in your sleep. I do have to say though, I do not judge anyone because many could be guilty of not wanting to do anything, like me.

Everyone would share what he or she thinks, and one of us would write everything that we were saying. Doing that every day helped us to finish our work easily without having so much confusion. This demonstrates how working in a group helps students to accomplish their task easily by sharing their ideas. The second reason working in a group is more beneficial is that it helps students to communicate to each others. For example, some students at school are unable to communicate with their classmates during classes. A good way to get those students to communicate with their classmates is by putting them in groups during projects, assignments, and class works. In conclusion, there are things in our lives that have both negative and positive effects. It has been said that a positive attitude is the key to success in life. Should schools control student involvement in extracurricular activities or should students and their families decide for themselves?

I think when it comes to extracurricular activities, students should decide if they want to join an extracurricular activity and also how theyre going to plan everything so schoolwork doesnt overlap.

One reason to support this is issue is that it is easier for them to make their own schedule so they are able to fit what they need to do such as school work or homework and then make time for the activity of their choice. They can be more organized and they can be more independent without having the schools getting involved. For example, if you do not have any homework on the days you have your extracurricular activities, you will be able to go for it. If there is homework and you possibly know you have an activity right after school, you can either plan to do whatever homework needs to be done the night before, or get it done during school if there is a study hall. In the morning can work too. This way your schoolwork wont interfere with your activities and you can also be caught up on all of your work. you can use different strategies that you are comfortable with.

Another reason that supports this issue is that if schools decide to get involved with extracurricular activities, they might make a schedule that does not really work for you. Sometimes it might be good to have a schedule set for you but sometimes it wont be beneficial for you / work for you. That is why students should make their own decisions when it comes to extracurricular activities. Students know how they can manage their schoolwork on their own, and as I said in my first reason, you can make your own schedule.

In conclusion, I think that if students make the decisions regarding extracurricular activities instead of schools making them, it can help students in many different ways. Students know what kind of schoolwork they have to be completed and they can set goals towards that and have time for activities after school. Parents may also know their childrens schedule and what they need to complete so it can be up to families to decide all together how they are going to plan everything out, stress free. These are the reasons why I support this issue.

BENEFITS OF A FOUR-DAY SCHOOL WEEK

Getting enough sleep is one of the best thing one could ever have! This is equivalent to having an extra day off at work or school. Therefore, schools should adopt the habit of a four-day school week by extending the school day two hours. The benefits of changing to a four-day school week, conserves energy and resources, improves academic performances and provides enough time to complete school assignments.

The amount of energy and resources used at school for a whole week is more than what we use at home. An example of such is electricity and water. The more we use, the more the school pays for it. That one extra day off reduces expenses in respect of food services,transportation and utilities.

Not only does the school conserves energy and resources, but also offers teachers and students an additional day for rest every week. As a result of that, there is less stress over school works. Students feel less pressured because they have enough rest at home before coming to school. This is an important factor that helps improve the academic performances of students.

Notwithstanding the fact that, the school conserves energy and resources, and provides enough rest, students will also have enough time to complete their assignments. Most students complain they do not get time at home, to finish up with the homework given to them by their teachers. When this continuously happens, it could drop down their grades. Having an additional day, making it three-day weekend instead of two, will give them more time to prepare for tests and study at their own pace.

Switching to a four-day school week will help change a lot. It would have a positive effect on the school, students and as well as the parents.

Schools should just stay with the required core classes, and if a student wishes to join a class where they give more attention to their career, they may. Students in high school should not be expected to take courses that guide the students to a specific career, because young students are not sure of what they want to pursue and specific courses can be too stressful for a young mind.

Is always working worth not taking a break? Those who are always active, can finish a lot of work; however, inactivity serves a purpose in our life. Being inactive sometimes is beneficial for people because they need a mental break, physical break and to stay healthy.

Firstly, being inactive sometimes is beneficial for people because they need a mental break. By taking a mental break people can come up with fresh and new ideas. Always working can take away people's ability to think about new and fresh idea's. Also, always working can make people be more serious and not be happy. If people are always doing something, that can cause them to have depression because people would be overworked. In conclusion, being inactive sometimes is beneficial for people because they need a mental break.

Secondly, being inactive sometimes is beneficial for people because they need a physical break. If people are always working, they wouldn't have enough time to spend with their family and family is one of the most important part of our life. In addition, friends are also very important part of our life's. If people are constantly working they can't visit their friends and this can cause a weak relationship between friends. If people always work they can't enjoy their life because they are constantly working. They wouldn't be able to do things they love doing. In conclusion, being inactive sometimes is beneficial for people because they need a physical break.

Thirdly, being inactive sometimes is beneficial for people because they need to stay healthy. Working a lot can cause problems to people's health. One major health risk can be a heart problem. Working a lot can cause stress and that is not good for people's health. Stress is known to cause heart problems, one major heart problem is heart attack, which it can translate to death. There was once a great artist that goes by the name Michelangelo, Michelangelo has done so many great things and said so many great things for the artist community. There was once when he said this famous quote that goes like, "The greater danger for most of us lies not in setting our aim too high and falling short; but in setting our aim too low and achieving our mark." Would you agree or disagree with Michelangelo's statement? in my opinion I would agree with Michelangelo. The quote is basically saying that when you want to achieve something, and you dont give it your all but you achieve your mark, you are basically lying to yourself and not giving it your all. But those are not all my reasons on why i support Michelangelo, I will tell you three examples on why I agree with Michelangelo

My first example on why I agree with Michelangelo is when you are trying out for team. I remember back in the ninth grade, we had soccer tryouts coming up and I was very excited but not ready, so I went to the field and waited for instructions on the coaches. It was a three day tryout so I was doing tasks but with no practice at all and messing up a few times. After the three days ended, the coaches gave us the results of everyone and who was qualified to be in the soccer team. I was looking but did not see my name anywhere, and it was because I did not make the team. So when the school year ended, I was practicing all summer long and soccer was all I had on my mind nothing else. After that when my sophomore year started, the tryouts in mid march got announced again and this time i was prepared after aiming high and not giving up, so I was at tryouts and the three days pass again and our coaches gave the results, but this time I was on the list for the team, and its all because i aimed high and achieved my mark like how Michelangelo said.

Example number two is school finals, I remember when I took my math final back in the eighth grade and was not ready at all, in fact I even guessed on the whole test because I was being selfish and decided not to study before. So i got my test results back and somehow I was eligible for a retake, to pass the final I needed a 400 or above and I got 378 enough for a retake. So I took that as some motivation and I studied day and night until I had it all jacked in my head and memorized for my retake. So test day came up and I aced the test, I knew what I was doing, I was taking my time and not rushing at all and I finished satisfied and happy. So a few days later my teacher passes us the results and my test score was 478, I was really proud of all that hard work I did it was all worth it. I achieved my mark after aiming high and not falling short like how Michelangelo once said.

Finally my last example is a sports final, so I love soccer and my favorite soccer team is Real Madrid, I remember back in 2010 we were in the semifinals of the league and lost. The loss was really upsetting and disappointing, but I knew that the loss was gonna switch things up to prevent that disaster again. So the president of the team decided to get some new players in the team and a new manager as well. After we got the new players I saw improvement and better chemistry between them, we were not loosing a single game and we were climbing in the league ranks a lot. We were in the semi finals again and the results were much better then last season, last season we lost 2-1, but this year we take the game 4-1, it was a big difference and that game took us to the league finals. So the game started and all I could see was us dominating the whole entire first half of the game, you could really see where the players were aiming for when they wanted better results this season, they could've been working on passing drills, or composure drills, and it all paid off in the end.

So in conclusion with Michelangelo's quote I highly agree with him, after all i did give three examples on why you should agree with Michelangelo as well. First it was with my soccer tryouts, I was going in there with no practice and ended in failure, but I took that failure and turned it into motivation and succeeded. Next was with my math finals test, I was being selfish and said,"I am going to pass without any study," and I failed. So like my soccer tryouts, I took my failure and made it into motivation to study and work day and night until I had it all memorized,and on test day i passed with a rocking 478. Last reason was my favorite soccer team's loss in the league, They did not have the mind set to win, so the president bought new players and a new manager as well. After that they went to the semi finals again and too took the victory home, after that they even took the final game home along with the title so what they basically did was they were aiming high, and practicing until they were better and thats what made them win the game and the title. So to wrap it all up, Michelangelo was correct on his quote and that it is true that "when you aim too high and fall short but in setting our aim too low and achieving the mark" works after all. Character traits are the way people behave.

Character traits can be inherited from people we surround ourselves with, like familiy and friends, but that does not mean that we have to be like them.

Anyone can choose their own character traits because everyone is different.

People have different personalities, manners, and behviors.

People have their own personalities. Some may be shy and others outgoing.

For example, little kids are shy when they are around people they do not know.

Most parents do not like when their kids are shy because they start to whine and act anti-social. Meanwhile, when they are at home they have a party of their life.

As kids grow up though, they begin to be a bit more outgoing.

They start to communicate and socialize more.

As kids grow up they are taught certain manners.

Parents start to educate them at home.

They may teach them basic manners like to say "please" and "thank you", greet people, share with others, etc. Parents teach their kids to be respectful but sometimes kids choose do otherwise.

For example, a little kid playing with someone else and all of a sudden they start to fight, not wanting to share their toys.

When kids grow up they behave different.

They learn new things and view things from a different perspective.

They change from being childish to maturue, like teenagers.

At a teenage stage they may want to be independent.

Teenagers may still not listen to their parents.

They begin to make their own decisions and choose their own lifestyle.

For example, wanting to drive on their own, dressing however they want to, etc.

In conclusion, people choose their own character traits no matter their age, how they are raised or what they are taught.

Our charcater traits are not formed by influences beyond our control.

We choose how to act, what to do, and what not to do.

Overtime, people do change but still choose their own character traits.

We do not have to be like people we surround ourselves with.

Seeking for Guidance

Many people have made their own decisions or even looked for guidance in experts before making their final decision. People who have made their own decisions have had benefits from it or learned from it by experiencing it themselves. However, seeking guidance from experts have benefited many people. People who have sought guidance have had a benefit of preventing wrong choices. Talking to someone who has experiences could help people understand if their choice is a good idea or not. Seeking guidance from experts is very helpful for many people.

It is a good choice for people to seek guidance instead of following his or her own instincts and ideas. The reason why seeking guidance is a better choice is because experts have had experiences similar to what the person seeking guidance, is thinking about. When people talk to an expert who knows what the advantages or disadvantages of the choice they're going to make, it helps them view the decision in the experts perspective. Talking to someone with experience can prevent people from making a decision they weren't sure about. When people don't really known what the outcome of their choice will be, they get confused on whether to do what they're thinking about or not not knowing how it could affect them.

Seeking guidance from an expert could prevent wrong decisions to be made. People aren't always sure about what they want to do so they do the first thing that comes to their mind. A while back, one of my friends was thinking about dropping out of high school their senior year. She seemed so determined about her idea and she asked me what I thought about it. I honestly didn't know what would have been the best for her so I told her to talk to the guidance counselor. When she finished speaking to the counselor about the idea she had she realized it was all the stress she had that was convincing her to drop out. The counselor helped her see that dropping out wouldn't have been any good for her future. The counselor even told her a disadvantage of dropping out was that finding a good paying job without a diploma would've been difficult. Just by talking to someone with experience can help prevent a wrong decision from happening.

Even though seeking guidance from an expert could benefit many people, there are other people who decide to make their own choices. Some people want to have their own experiences on the decision they're going to make. Whether their decision is good or bad they'd rather learn from it. Some people believe that there could be many experiences and they won't all turn out the same every time. Another one of my friends also thought about dropping out and she ended up doing it without seeking guidance from an expert. When she decided that she was going to make her own choice she knew it probably wouldn't have turned out the way she wanted. Luckily, a few months later she was able to start her own business in makeup and do good. She tells me "What if I never went with my instinct? Would I have been where I am at now?" Just like my friend some people believe that they should just go with their instinct. They want to either learn from their choice or benefit from it.

In conclusion, whether you make your own choice or seek for a guidance's help you will learn and benefit from the choice you'll make. Making you're own choice isn't always good sometimes things don't turn out the way you expected it or maybe it does, but you're never positive on what will happen based on your decision. Seeking guidance from an expert is a very god advantage for many people because it can help them view the decision they want to make in the experts perspective. Talking to a expert can help prevent you from making a decision you're not sure about. Seeking some guidance isn't always a bad idea.

Now let's think about how long would it be if the school adds one hour and a half to school each day. I disagree with extending the school day because students will have very short time to play sports or participate in fun activities after school, will have more work, and have less time with their families and friends.

To begin playing sports help us stay mentally and physically healthy, but with tired body and brain activities might become so challenging for you. Additionally, injuries can occur. Also you will have homework, and you will have to do your favorite activity and homework together, and you need to be fast enough to do them in approximately three hours. For example, you play volleyball, and after the practices you went home. It was 6:30, then you toke a shower and ate dinner. Therefore, longer school hours will led students to have lower grades and maybe bad behaviors.

In conclusion, the school board should not extend the school day because students will not have time to play sports, will have more work, and have less time with their families. Students are often given projects they don't like, but if they design them they could be a lot more drawn to work on them. Because is break, students shouldn't be working on a project they don't enjoy, they could choose to do a project about something they like. Summer projects should be student-designed, this would make the projects feel more personal.

If students could design their own projects they would be more motivated to work on them. I once was assigned a summer project about whales, a topic I'm not really interested in. I didn't really worked on the project during break and waited until the last week of break to work on it and didn't really do my best on it. If students choose to do their projects about a topic they are passionate about, they will be more motivated to learn more about the topic and work on the project.

Students should design a project they would feel confident doing. Everyone is different and every student is interested in a different topic. My sister was assigned a project about cooking, that is something she enjoys a lot, she finished the project the same day it was assigned. A curfew has been imposed in some parts of the US, according to which a teenager should always be accompanied by an adult outside their home after a particular time at night. I somewhat agree with this change and will be discussing this further. 
 During their teenage years, children are very eager to explore the outside world and are very susceptible to influence from social media. They might witness elder siblings and fictional characters on TV going out at night, partying and drinking alcohol and having fun. This can lead to teenagers sneaking out alone at night and indulging in under-age alcohol consumption which may have adverse effects on their health. 
 Secondly, it is very dangerous to venture out at night due to the high crime rate. Young teens can fall easy prey to robbers, muggers and other criminals. The presence of an adult ensures they will be kept safe and stay out of trouble. 
 However, there are some drawbacks to this curfew as well. We want children to understand their responsibilities from a young age. To this effect, in many states children can start working at age 14, apply for a driving licence at age 16 and even get married when they turn 18. Keeping this in mind it would be contradictory to then impose a curfew on teenagers going out alone at night. 
 In my opinion, imposing a curfew is a step in the right direction. I first hand experience my friend rebelling against his parents at a young age and going out unsupervised at night. He fell in with the wrong crowd, started drink alcohol, using drugs, dropped out of school and ultimately ended up in jail.
